title.zh: 宣布每年 8 月 31 日为三描礼士省特别非工作公共假日，以纪念前总统 Ramon Magsaysay 诞辰的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring August Thirty-first of Each Year a Special Nonworking Public Holiday in the Province of Zambales to Commemorate the Birth Anniversary of Former President Ramon Magsaysay
title.orig: An Act Declaring August Thirty-first of Each Year a Special Nonworking Public Holiday in the Province of Zambales to Commemorate the Birth Anniversary of Former President Ramon Magsaysay

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1994/ra_7792_1994.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: In order to commemorate the birth anniversary of former President Ramon Magsaysay, August Thirty-first of each year is hereby declared a special nonworking public holiday in the Province of Zambales.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in at least two (2) newspapers of general circulation.
